summary: Verified the /brands 'needs attention' phantom-count bug fix (follow-up to iter_197). Backend GET /api/dashboard/brands for owner (user 1) now returns attention_count=0 for company 1 (The Dev Store) and summary.attention_count=0 for all periods (today/7d/30d/90d/1y/all). The per-brand 'attention' breakdown now contains ONLY {stuck_forwards, coins_without_wallet, webhook_failures} with no 'failed_conversions' key. Reconciled the 3 previously-counted failed conversions for company 1 via ro_query: tx 883 has attention_resolved_at=2026-09-18T04:15:00Z, tx 933 & 934 both have forwarded=true (outgoing_tx_hash set) — all 3 are correctly non-actionable and no longer counted. Regression checks: endpoint still auth-gated (401 without token), summary still returns brand_count/settled_amount/payments_count/pending_amount, still sorts by settled DESC with is_new last, and honours ?period (today=$0, 7d=$1,131.18, 30d=$5,149.36, 90d=$16,900.40, 1y=$31,847.06, all=$31,847.06 — all>=prior period). Note: only 3 brands are now returned (1, 71, 165) instead of the 5 seen in iter_197 because brands 219 (QA BuyerEmail Test) and 228 (QA HashKeys Brand) have been soft-deleted (deleted_at set to 2026-09-18); this is a data-state change unrelated to this fix. No brand on current prod has a genuine stuck-forward / coin-without-wallet / recent webhook failure, so all attention counts are 0 — confirmed correct query shape, no fabricated data. Frontend /brands: The Dev Store card (brand-card-1) shows 'Needs attention 0' in brand-attention-1, summary tile brands-sum-attention shows 0, no phantom count. Because every brand attention_count=0, the attention tile is correctly NOT a role=button and not clickable (attribute role=None on all three tiles) — the clickable>0 drill-in path cannot be exercised on current READ-ONLY prod data and was not forced. Range presets refetch and update summary correctly (7D->$1,131.18, All->$31,847.06). 3 brand cards rendered. No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 390x844.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed. Owner (user 1) now has only 3 brands visible on /brands (1 The Dev Store $31,516.23; 71 SMADAV $310.85; 165 Nameword $19.98) — brands 219 & 228 were soft-deleted on 2026-09-18. All attention counts are 0 on current prod data (no genuine stuck-forwards / coins-without-wallet / recent webhook failures). The attention drill-in (role=button when >0) cannot be exercised in read-only mode. Reconciliation: failed-conversion tx 883/933/934 for company 1 are correctly non-actionable (883 resolved; 933 & 934 forwarded). Breakdown object keys are exactly {stuck_forwards, coins_without_wallet, webhook_failures}.
rca of the issue: Previous brandAttention query counted a raw all-time COUNT of FAILED stablecoin conversions, including those already resolved (attention_resolved_at IS NOT NULL) or already forwarded (outgoing_tx_hash IS NOT NULL). Merchant payouts view intentionally hides FAILED conversions (services/payouts/payoutQueries.conversionsNeedingAttention filters them out), so the brand card's attention tile surfaced a count the merchant could never open. Fix removes the failed_count subquery from brandAttention, and controller now computes attention_count = stuck_forwards + coins_without_wallet + (webhook_failures>0 ? 1 : 0) — matching the merchant-visible payouts feed. Verified end-to-end on prod data.
